summary: The children of an elderly Chinese mother have touched the hearts of millions by painstakingly building a new staircase by hand up the side of a mountain to help her reach her home more easily. Her youngest daughter said that she remembers her mother holding their hands down the old mountain path in her childhood, and that now it was “their turn” to hold hers. Born and raised on the top of a mountain in eastern China’s Zhejiang Province, the children moved their mother into town after their father died decades ago, where she alternated stays between her eldest and second-eldest son homes. She never took to urban life.
